text:
Ten project controls dashboards. One browser. No licence.

These are the tools I wanted on site as a planner, so I built them:

• Piping progress on the plot plan, and a 4D playback of plan vs actual
• Welder, crane and scaffolding productivity
• Steel, civil, E&I and equipment progress
• Daily progress for reconstruction works

Each one is a single HTML file. It opens on a phone and works offline. Several refresh from a new Excel file.

All demos run on fictional data: https://osman2k4-dot.github.io/Dashboards/

I am a project controls manager in Abu Dhabi with 16+ years in planning and scheduling. If your project needs a baseline schedule, a schedule review or a dashboard like these, send me a message.
